definition: Showing excessive confidence about having rights or abilities.
author: Emily Brontë
quote: At present he’s discharged from the trouble of calling; owing to some presumptuous aspirations after Miss Linton which he manifested.
example_sentence: It felt presumptuous to book the restaurant before she had said yes.
